Closing verification (sanctioned non-force path). Ticked all 3 ACs after re-verifying on main @9bdb22f5887:
- AC1 root cause: the metric backend's presence depended on ambient PATH (a locally-installed scc/lizard makes the tiny fixture produce no metric evidence record). Fixed by commit 81b3b5929423a641cbf9dbf806796599df01d59f, which pins engine_b._METRIC_CANDIDATES to a missing tool at tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py:100.
- AC2 verified now: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py -q -> 5 passed, AC5 table shows 'metric ran=0 skipped=1 reasons={no_tool: 1}'.
- AC3 the assertions at tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py:112-115 pin the per-backend account (metric present, skipped>=1, reason no_tool>=1) so the same drift fails loudly.
Linked duplicates -> 8322-6f05-ea1b-4da1 (the canonical root-cause ticket, closed). Checkbox ticks are attestation-safe (box state is normalized out of the material fingerprint; docs/plan-review-gate.md).
